messages.en: Have you seen those two designs? What do you think?
I reckon we should just go with this design. It's clearer.
Has the pilot boarded that ship yet?
Yes. We're just waiting there for instructions now.

senses.en_definition: To call someone to come or return, for example by saying their name.
To invite someone to an event or gathering.
To refer to or address someone or something by a particular name or title.

messages.en: I'm heading to the night market in a bit. Wanna come?
Yeah! Give me a shout when you're about to head off. I'll be at home.
Okay, I'll stop by your place on the way.

senses.en_definition: The sound of a voice calling out.
An instance of communication by telephone; a phone call.
A summons or invitation to go somewhere or attend something.
A name or title used to address or refer to someone.
A strong inner inclination or sense of purpose that draws someone to a particular occupation or field.
A person who is summoned or called in.

collocations.en: a person who is called in
a worker called in as needed

messages.en: I called you earlier, but you didn't pick up. Were you busy?
Sorry, I couldn't take your call earlier because I was driving. I'm home now. Want me to call you back now?
